codex.lore: [Cosmic Guardian — Tier IX] Abyssion, 'The Dimensional Maw' — Guardian of Collapse. Where Alphaea creates order, Abyssion governs destruction: he consumes unstable dimensions before their corruption can spread across the Expanse, devouring broken realities, failed timelines, dimensional infections and unstable astralite zones. Entire worlds have vanished within his jaws. His body is a cosmic dragon of fractured reality, scaled in black, red and blue — the architecture of collapse made flesh. Terrible, but necessary — without collapse, reality would accumulate corruption until existence itself became unsustainable. — In the Cosmic Mirror Cycle, Abyssion governs Quadrant III, the Trinity Zone (--): the collapse state, where only body, mind and spirit remain. — Lineage: one of the four dracolords, born of Azyrath from gathered space matter — among the six survivors of the Aenor Eruption's great dying, and a founder of the Eternal Accord.

codex.lore: [Cosmic Guardian — Tier IX] Aetherion, 'The Prism Tyrant' — Guardian of Evolution. He governs adaptation, mutation, astralite evolution, cosmic transformation and infinite growth, embodying the law that existence must continuously evolve to survive. His body endlessly changes form, colour and structure as he absorbs new astralite frequencies; his armour catches every frequency at once — prism-cut plates over a body of rainbow astralite, the spectrum-consciousness made visible. Many believe the Astralite Matrix itself partly reflects his influence. He is both the creator of advancement and the source of uncontrollable mutation. — In the Cosmic Mirror Cycle, Aetherion governs Quadrant I, the Alpha Zone (++): pure alignment, the existence closest to its intended form. — Lineage: one of the four dracolords, born of Azyrath from gathered space matter — among the six survivors of the Aenor Eruption's great dying, and a founder of the Eternal Accord.

codex.lore: [Cosmic Guardian — Tier IX] Aethravax, 'The Twin Dominion' — Guardian of Cosmic Polarity, and the rarest and most mysterious of the six. He governs duality, balance through opposition, simultaneous creation and destruction, astralite polarity and cosmic judgment. His body is contradiction made form: one wing of radiant astralite, one wing of abyssal void, an emerald world-core at his centre; his head a crowned dragon-skull with red eyes set in the bone — a sovereign of contradiction, judging from inside the body of judgment itself. He exists so that no single force ever dominates existence — the balance between Alphaea's order and Abyssion's collapse. Ancient records name him 'The Guardian Who Judges the Guardians.' — In the Cosmic Mirror Cycle, Aethravax governs Quadrant II, the Dichotomy Zone (-+): internal conflict held in controlled imbalance. — Lineage: one of the four dracolords, born of Azyrath from gathered space matter — among the six survivors of the Aenor Eruption's great dying, and a founder of the Eternal Accord.

All other humanoid races carry diluted Ultramax through generational descent; Anciuxor carries direct Ultramax through manifestation channel.

★ NARRATIVE FUNCTION: Anciuxor's Ultramax/Humanoid-Noid typing is the mechanical reason mortals can perceive him in Realm I-II contexts (the Humanoid-Noid half makes him mortal-perceivable) while still carrying full Highest-One cosmic-correction authority (the Ultramax half is Ultharis's substrate manifest). Anciuxor does NOT operate in Realm III (Anciara) or Realm IV (Omnithris) — those are direct-Ultharis-presence realms where Anciuxor's interface function is unnecessary.]

See Page 4 COSMIC THEORY v9.6 patch 46 block.]

★ Anciuxor is the PHYSICAL MANIFESTATION of ULTHARIS (# 349 · Tier X+ TRANSCENDENT · THE HIGHEST ONE itself) within the lower realms of existence. The relationship: ULTHARIS = transcendent source / cosmic author · ANCIUXOR = embodied interface. ★ CLOSES the prior canon-cleanup flag noted as 'Anciuxor physical-manifestation vs superseded/OPEN coexist unreconciled' — resolution is HIERARCHICAL not contradictory: Ultharis (source) → Anciuxor (manifestation). Anciuxor is the physical manifestation of the Highest One within the lower realms of existence. It does not rule through emotion or conquest, but through absolute cosmic correction and balance. Appearing only during Cosmic Crises, it stands above Immortals, Gemlords, and all known forms of life. As the All-Seeing Gatekeeper and the Father, Anciuxor sits cleanly at Tier X — witness and overseer of the Eternal Accord, standing above the six Dracolord Guardians though he is not a Dracolord himself. His card is a one-of-one, Creator-owned: the single rarest card in the TCG, and is never to be reprinted.

★ v14.5 · ULTIMATE TYPE LOCK: Retyped from Ultramax/Humanoid (ASCENDANCE) → **ULTIMATE** single-type · ABSOLUTE archetype. ULTIMATE is a new canonical 21st type reserved EXCLUSIVELY for Tier X God cards. Type rules: NO WEAKNESSES (immune to every other type · 1× incoming from all 20) · 3× EFFECTIVENESS against every other type · SINGLE-TYPE only (no dual/tri) · immune to all 5 statuses · uncatchable by Zysphere/Zycube/Zyramid · T×333 exempt (999×5=4995). codex.lore:
[Cosmic Guardian — Tier IX] Azyrath, 'The Hollow Empress' — Guardian of the Void. She governs emptiness, silence, gravity, cosmic hollowness and suspended existence. At her centre lives a singularity, the Hollow Core, through which she controls planetary compression, gravitational fields, void-born energy and celestial suspension. Her form is wrapped in astral robes, the black-red singularity of the Hollow Core visible at her centre — the Hollow Empress made manifest. Azyrath ensures reality never becomes overcrowded with uncontrolled matter and energy — she is the stillness between existence. — In the Cosmic Mirror Cycle, Azyrath holds the centre with Alphaea: Aenor, the galactic heart. — Lineage: Azyrath is the one direct child of Anciuxor and Alphaea — the survivor-matriarch who sheltered her own children through the great dying. From gathered space matter she bore the four dracolords: Abyssion, Aetherion, Abominalys and Aethravax. One of the last six Dracolords, a founder of the Eternal Accord, and the cosmic lynchpin. ★ v13.16 pairing lock: Azyrath ANCHORS ZORYTH (The Lowest Eye · The Great Moon) at the center of the Expanse · complementary to Alphaea who anchors Aenor.

★ v14.3 · HOLLOW CORE METAPHOR LOCK: Azyrath 'carries the Hollow Core' — this is a METAPHOR for her Void substrate as Survivor-Matriarch, NOT a separate artifact. The Hollow Core describes her canonical role: she turns emptiness into protection · shelters the surviving line · proves that preservation may require silence, gravity, and terrible endurance. Not one of the 16 Ancient Prisms · not a separate named object · her CORE POWER expressed in mythic language.

★ COSMIC TRINITY RELATIONSHIP (final lock):
  · ELZORAN = eternal identity (V Apex pure baseline) — BOOKENDS the corruption arc

★ EURAKEON's CURRENT CANONICAL STATE: Self-sufficient cosmic-being · seated at ZYRAXIS #9 as one of the 10 cosmic Gemlords · representing the PURPLE gem-substrate register. He carries forward the cosmic-shadow-substrate signature that originated in Elzoran's corruption · but he is no longer dependent on Elzoran for existence. His sovereignty over the Purple Gemlord position is independent · earned through the cosmic-substrate self-sufficiency event at Origon's Father Gem.

★ MAJOR RETCON: Eurakeon is NOT a Mandrake royal line from Draevos. Prior v9.6 patch 11 reference to 'Mandrakes — Elzoran & Eurakeon royal lines' is RETIRED. Eurakeon's actual canonical origin chain:
  (1) OMEGORAN (# 219 · Tier VII Pseudoimmortal · Beast/Unknown-Void) carried an internal PURPLE/SHADOW ESSENCE within his cosmic-substrate
  (2) The essence was PURGED from Omegoran in a foundational cosmic-prehistory event (details ◆ open canon)
  (3) Omegoran reverted to his original form: ELZORAN (# 98 · Tier V Apex · Beast/Nature) — Elzoran IS the purified Omegoran without his purple-shadow contaminant
  (4) The purged purple/shadow essence acted with cosmic-purpose: it TRAVELED TO ORIGON #1 seeking MORE POWER (drawn by the Father Gem core's ambient cosmic-substrate density)
  (5) At Origon · the essence COALESCED into a being — EURAKEON (this card · Tier VIII Immortal) — born of cosmic-shadow-substrate seeking the Father Gem amplification
  (6) Voltyran (# 337 · Origon-native Tier VI Pseudoimmortal) defended Origon against the newly-formed Eurakeon
  (7) Eurakeon LOST the defensive battle — failed to acquire the Father Gem's power · was REPELLED by Voltyran's home-field cosmic-substrate amplification (which let Voltyran fight effectively above tier)
  (8) ★ Eurakeon FLED — survived to escape Origon · traveled to ZYRAXIS #9 · settled there and BECAME THE PURPLE GEMLORD (one of the 10 cosmic Gemlords of Zyraxis · alongside Mutaryn the Citirinelord · etc.)

  · Cosmic role: THE PURPLE GEMLORD — one of the 10 cosmic Gemlords of Zyraxis · representing the purple-gem cosmic-substrate register
  · Origin of his shadow/void cosmic-substrate: Omegoran's purged essence

★ ELZORAN/OMEGORAN/EURAKEON COSMIC LINEAGE LOCK:
  · ELZORAN = the original/pure form (Tier V Apex) — what Omegoran becomes when his shadow essence is purged
  · OMEGORAN = the contaminated form (Tier VII Pseudoimmortal) — Elzoran while carrying the purple/shadow essence inside him
  · EURAKEON = the separated essence (Tier VIII Immortal) — the purged shadow-substrate given its own cosmic-being form
All three are cosmically related through the Omegoran-Purge event. They are not three separate beings born independently — they are the THREE COSMIC STATES of a single original cosmic-substrate moment.

★ NARRATIVE FUNCTION: Eurakeon is the saga's FIRST EXAMPLE OF A PURGED-ESSENCE BEING — the cosmic-mechanism precedent for later corruption-vessel arcs (Khronis's Vice-essence vessel state · Khronicore's corrupted-Onyaxius arc · Malzareth's vampire-engineering line). Eurakeon's escape and rise to Gemlord-tier on Zyraxis demonstrates that purged-essence beings can survive defeat and become cosmic powers in their own right — a template Khronis's saga arc follows ~10 billion years later.

★ COSMIC ORIGIN: Eurakeon is canonically a MANDRAKE ROYAL LINE figure from DRAEVOS #3 (: 'Mandrakes — Elzoran & Eurakeon royal lines' on Draevos). Tier VIII Immortal · the cosmic-substrate authority of his Mandrake-lineage royalty.

★ ★ THE FAMOUS BATTLE AT ORIGON: Eurakeon TRAVELED TO ORIGON in cosmic prehistory and clashed with VOLTYRAN (# 337 · Tier VI Pseudoimmortal · Origon-native). Despite the 2-tier advantage (VIII vs VI) · the battle was closely contested because Voltyran's HOME-FIELD COSMIC-SUBSTRATE (Father Gem core) amplified the native's effective combat-tier into the VII-VIII range on Origon's surface. Battle is one of the EARLIEST KNOWN battles in saga canon · likely predates the Aenor Eruption's full cosmic-substrate stabilization.

★ NARRATIVE FUNCTION: Eurakeon is the saga's canonical FIRST-VISITOR-TO-ORIGON figure · the Mandrake royal line representative who pioneered cosmic-interplanetary travel from Draevos to Origon. His battle with Voltyran establishes the cosmic-battle-record that all subsequent saga conflicts descend from.

★ OPEN CANON: The outcome of the Voltyran-Eurakeon battle · cosmic-substrate effects on the broader Expanse · whether this battle was witnessed/recorded by which other cosmic figures.

Eurakeon was born from ruin — the shadow aura that Anciuxor purged from Omegoran (the corruption of Elzoran) did not die. Its remnants drifted free and coalesced into a new being: Eurakeon — the Eurakeon line, a shadow Mandrake born of that purged corruption and the dark cosmic cousin to humanity's Elzoran line. He governs will, identity and the fragile nature of consciousness; his presence bends thought and turns certainty into chaos — the Amethystlord, shaped from the very darkness that once claimed a dragon. Rare among beings, Eurakeon can travel the cosmos under his own power; he slipped the Corefall and vanished, and now wanders the Expanse as a loose, roaming threat whose true goal is the Father Gem at Origon's core — heavily guarded by the planet's gem-bound natives.

★ v14.3 · ORIGIN LOCK: Eurakeon was born as an INDEPENDENT BEING from ELZORAN'S PURGED CORRUPTION on Draevos. When Elzoran became Omegoran, the purged corrupted portion of his substrate crystallized into Eurakeon — who then drifted through the Expanse seeking a substrate dense enough to host him, eventually arriving on Zyraxis to crystallize as the Amethyst/Purple Gemlord of Netharion (District V). His v11.19 'expelled from Origon by Voltyran' arc is reframed: he was never on Origon to be expelled — he emerged on Draevos as Elzoran's discarded corruption.

[Daemon Prime] The architect of all engineered corruption in Viridia — Malrec Malviros, the ancient Daemon Prime called Khronis, who abandoned natural order for controlled evolution and absolute power. A towering winged humanoid of pale hardened flesh and crown-curved horns, veins lit with corrupted astral energy; fully sentient, calculating and methodical, he regards the world as a system to be rewritten, and is the creator of the Morispore lineage and the force behind every hybrid and ritual transformation. In the modern era he operates through Khronis Corporation — daemon-cult corruption evolved into a Sith-like hidden corporate elite running 'Astral Capitalism,' profiting from the disasters it engineers. His true goal is controlled collapse, not money; he stays young by consuming the blood of powerful Astrals (the literal 'eat and drink people'), and has bought UMBRIS into a bargain that hunts the AUR- bloodline and other high Astrals on his behalf. Shown here in his A4 Awakening — the Khronicore Endgame Sacrifice — where he consumes his own Armageddon Dragon entirely, tearing out its astral core and fusing dragon, Mori and daemon essence into raw corrupted density. The sky fractured, the ground ruptured, and the Veil weakened as the Underworld bled into Viridia. Khronis did not ascend with his dragon — he devoured it to become something greater.

★ v14.3 · MALREC MALVIROS BACKSTORY LOCK: Khronis began as MALREC MALVIROS — a survivor whose family was massacred in Viridia's SOUTHERN wilds. Saved but not restored by VITRIARCH (Vice Immortal of Corruption · Vice of Nature register), Malrec was raised beneath the doctrine that power must be TAKEN rather than earned. He retreated beneath the WESTERN MOUNTAINS and created the first legions of MORI through blood ritual and corrupted transformation. The name KHRONIS marks the moment survival became a claim of ownership over everyone else's future. His power moves through KHRONEXUS (his named artifact/system) · the weakened Veil · and the systems built across earlier wars to prepare his ascension. In Bk VIII (Equinox War · 2026-2031 CE), Andre Hart ascends as Auraxion and seals Khronis, proving that inheritance and pain do not have to become tyranny.

Orryx was once a living sea-captain on a maritime world of the Aethryx Expanse (planet TBD · likely one of the 26 earlier worlds). Then a cosmic-ocean cataclysm — a maelstrom-tier event · a leviathan-class predator · or a cursed tidal register (mortal record disagrees on which) — consumed his entire family in one event. He survived alone.

★ THE BARGAIN
Consumed by grief and cosmic-rage · Orryx bargained with dark cosmic-substrate registers of the deep. He traded his mortal life (and the possibility of ever seeing his family again) in exchange for cosmic-substrate power and endless duration to pursue his vendetta. His body transformed into eternally-wet spectral flesh · his vessel became a phantom ship capable of sailing any cosmic-substrate sea across any world. He became the GHOST-CAPTAIN.

★ MOTIVE: TIDE-REVENGE + OCEANIC DOMINATION
Orryx no longer distinguishes between the sea that took his family and the cosmic-substrate seas of every world. He seeks to CONTROL every ocean — to become the absolute master of the oceanic register that once consumed him. Only through cosmic-oceanic sovereignty can he invert the tragedy that defined him. Every ship he wrecks · every sailor he consumes · is a small correction to the cosmic-substrate imbalance he refuses to accept.

Orryx heard of Xenoxil — an off-Zyraxis primordial who had achieved unofficial Gemlord register — and saw in Xenoxil's cosmic-substrate mastery the teachings he needed to truly conquer the cosmic-seas. He teamed up with Ophira (who had her own reasons for confronting Xenoxil) and CHALLENGED Xenoxil at Zyraxis. Xenoxil defeated them both without killing them. In the aftermath, Xenoxil offered them a deal: become his students, and he would teach them the cosmic-substrate techniques required to actually achieve their goals. Orryx accepted.

- Publicly loyal to Xenoxil
- Privately always plotting his own oceanic conquest
- Trusts NO ONE — not Xenoxil, not Ophira, certainly not his own spectral sailors (whom he uses as expendable cosmic-substrate weapons)
- His long-term ambition: acquire enough cosmic-oceanic sovereignty to break free from Xenoxil's tutelage and become an independent oceanic register-lord

Orryx confronts Auraxion during the Zyraxis arc of Book IX. Their fight likely occurs across a cosmic-substrate ocean or aboard Orryx's phantom vessel. Represents Auraxion's opportunity to grapple with grief-turned-corruption as a cosmic-substrate register.

★ TRAGIC ARC
His tragedy: he slowly COMPROMISES HIS MORALITY in pursuit of stability. His original Ghost Captain grief (family lost to cosmic-ocean cataclysm · v11.4) made him seek eternal cosmic-order at any cost — but each moral compromise takes him further from the honor he originally sought.

codex.lore: Voidward is what Steelward becomes when the gate finally falls and the oath has no one left to keep. It returned without permission, hauling itself from a sarcophagus no one had bothered to seal, missing one eye and carrying something else behind the other. The smoke is not from the tomb; the smoke is from whatever part of the watchman did not come back with the rest.
codex.card:
Voidward
Tier III Champion · Humanoid-Noid / Unknown-Void
HP 200 · ATK 215 · DEF 215 · SPD 145 · SPC 224  (Total 999)

A1 — Crypt Stride — 1 gem · 33% ATK ~71 damage
It crosses the ground the way it crossed out of its own unsealed tomb — unhurried, uninvited — and the strike carries the cold of the place it left.

A2 — Hollow Vow — 2 gems · inflicts Souldrift
It speaks the old oath back at the foe, hollowed out, meaning nothing now — and an empty vow laid on someone begins, quietly, to hollow them in turn.

A3 — Final Oath Inversion — 3 gems · 99% ATK ~213 damage & Souldrift
It takes the duty it once kept and turns it inside out — where Steelward shielded, Voidward unmakes, the watchman's last purpose spent on undoing.

The smoke is from whatever part of the watchman did not come back with the rest.

codex.lore:
Volcarith was born at the seam where the lava-fields meet the night tide, a contradiction the world has not figured out how to resolve. Its body holds the ocean and its spine holds the eruption, and neither has been able to extinguish the other. It runs the black coasts alone — the only thing that has ever managed to carry both fires at once.

★ v14.3 · FIRST FAMILY OF ORIGON LOCK (#508): Volcarith is Elzoran's other parent — tide and eruption carried in one body. Origon-native. Alongside VOLTYRAN forms the earliest known native family of Origon. Their child Elzoran inherits a draconic body capable of carrying the First World's creation-substrate beyond its own sky.
codex.card:
Volcarith
Tier III Champion · Beast / Nature
HP 235 · ATK 249 · DEF 165 · SPD 200 · SPC 150  (Total 999)

A1 — Magmaflood Charge — 1 gem · 33% ATK ~82 damage
It charges, and the lava it carries floods ahead of it down the black sand — the strike arrives already burning, with the creature close behind.

A2 — Geyser Stomp — 2 gems · inflicts Overcook
It stamps once, and the seam where lava meets tide answers — a geyser of scalding water and fire opening under the foe, refusing afterward to close.

A3 — Tidefire Eruption — 3 gems · 99% ATK ~247 damage & Overcook
It lets the ocean and eruption it has carried in one body all its life finally meet on the foe — the contradiction the world never resolved, settled.

Volcarith is the only thing that has ever managed to carry both fires at once.
